quotes.quote: Ventra Tickets: Single-ride and one-day passes.
Ventra is the convenient fare payment system for CTA, Pace and Metra that allows customers to pay for train and bus rides throughout Chicagoland.
Merchants in this category include operators of passenger trains, buses, taxis, limousines, rideshare, ferries, toll bridges and highways, and parking lots and garages.
Select transit includes car rentals, ferries, commuter railways, subways
